With the   guard gone the boot waits the 20 s constant and the case's wall assertion (below 10 s) fails about 20 s in, under   nextest's default profile (no kill line); `holds` = the case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line. - `capture-keys` — entry 3, `--timeout 300`; guard: the key-name filter in `capture.rs` (a name outside   `[a-z_]{1,40}` counted in `other_keys`, never listed); edit: the filter's predicate replaced by `true`; case: the   unit case on an off-pattern key name. With the guard gone that name is listed in `keys` and the case's assertion   fails. Read `holds` by the stopped run (`evidence/control-1.txt`). - `capture-source` — entry 3, `--timeout 300`; guard: the closed `source` words (a string outside the two wake words   reads `other`); edit: the `other` arm returns the string as given; case: the unit case on a `user` source. With   the guard gone the case reads `user` and fails. Read `holds` by the stopped run (`evidence/control-1.txt`). - `wake-capture` — entry 4, `--timeout 600`; guard: the capture sign in `wake.rs` (a capture line past send 1's   mark tells the fired wake); edit: that branch's condition replaced by `false`; case: the `r3` rehearsal with a   capture line. Read `holds` by the stopped run (`evidence/control-3.txt`). - `user-config-mark` — entry 3, `--timeout 300` (revision 1, inputs#I6 item 3); guard: the mark search in   `isolate.rs` (a needle found in the moved file reads `changed-by-rig`); edit: the search's found-predicate replaced   by `false`; case: the unit case «stamp moved, the path mark present». With the guard gone that case reads   `changed-by-others` and fails (predicted, unmeasured until implement fires it); `holds` = the case FAILED.
